description: This source file implements OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) parsing, verification, and request creation functions within the Chromium project's net/cert/pki/ocsp module. It includes functions for parsing OCSP responses, verifying signatures, matching certificate IDs, and generating OCSP requests and URLs.

classes.name: OCSPCertID
classes.description: Represents the OCSP Certificate Identifier used to match certificates in OCSP responses.

classes.name: OCSPSingleResponse
classes.description: Represents a single OCSP response for a certificate, including its status and update times.

classes.name: OCSPResponseData
classes.description: Contains the response data from an OCSP response, including responder ID, produced time, and individual responses.

classes.name: OCSPResponse
classes.description: Represents the overall OCSP response, including response status and embedded response data.

classes.name: OCSPVerifyResult
classes.description: Holds the result of OCSP verification, including status codes and error details.

methods.name: ParseOCSPCertID
methods.description: Parses raw TLV data into an OCSPCertID structure.

methods.name: ParseRevokedInfo
methods.description: Parses revoked certificate info from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseCertStatus
methods.description: Parses certificate status (good, revoked, unknown) from raw TLV data.

methods.name: AppendHashAsOctetString
methods.description: Appends a hash of a value as an OCTET STRING to a CBB buffer.

methods.name: ParseOCSPSingleResponse
methods.description: Parses a single OCSP response from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseResponderID
methods.description: Parses a ResponderID structure from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponseData
methods.description: Parses OCSP ResponseData from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseBasicOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses a BasicOCSPResponse structure from raw TLV data.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses an entire OCSP response from raw TLV data.

methods.name: VerifyHash
methods.description: Verifies that a hash of a value matches a given hash.

methods.name: GetSubjectPublicKeyBytes
methods.description: Extracts the subjectPublicKey bytes from a SubjectPublicKeyInfo TLV.

methods.name: CheckCertIDMatchesCertificate
methods.description: Checks if an OCSPCertID matches a given certificate and issuer.

methods.name: OCSPParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate into a ParsedCertificate object.

methods.name: CheckResponderIDMatchesCertificate
methods.description: Checks if a ResponderID matches a given certificate.

methods.name: VerifyAuthorizedResponderCert
methods.description: Verifies that a responder certificate is authorized for OCSP signing by the issuer.

methods.name: VerifyOCSPResponseSignatureGivenCert
methods.description: Verifies OCSP response signature using a given certificate.

methods.name: VerifyOCSPResponseSignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature of an OCSP response, either directly or via a delegated responder.

methods.name: ParseOCSPResponseDataExtensions
methods.description: Parses extensions in OCSP ResponseData, rejecting unrecognized critical extensions.

methods.name: ParseOCSPSingleResponseExtensions
methods.description: Parses extensions in a SingleResponse, handling known extensions and rejecting unrecognized critical ones.

methods.name: GetRevocationStatusForCert
methods.description: Determines the revocation status for a certificate based on OCSP responses.

methods.name: CheckOCSP
methods.description: Main function to verify OCSP response status for a certificate, including signature and response validation.

methods.name: CreateOCSPRequest
methods.description: Creates a DER-encoded OCSP request for a certificate.

methods.name: CreateOCSPGetURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for OCSP GET request with base64-encoded request data.
